prompt:
Penjelasan fitur baru untuk Saling Jaga

1. Voice notes (v0.24.0): with nothing typed, the send button records up to a minute of AAC at 24 kbit/s, about 180 KB, with "Terkirim ke" receipts. Phones announce that they can play them, so 0.23 phones are never sent one and stay connected. A test failed once in CI: the note went out before the owner had read one member's announcement. The fix waits for a text from each phone first, since frames on one link arrive in order
2. An offline disaster and first-aid guide (v0.25.0): six disasters and ten first-aid topics, from CPR to snake bites, with emergency numbers that open the dialer. It opens without a group
3. English as well as Indonesian (v0.26.0), and a new layout in v0.27.0
